beats.say: KKR bid twenty-five point two crore rupees for Cameron Green. So why does he only take home eighteen?
Blame an IPL rule most fans have never heard of.
lines: most fans have never heard of.

beats.say: At a mini-auction, an overseas player's salary is capped.
The cap is the lower of two numbers: the top retention price, eighteen crore, or the biggest bid at the last mega auction.
lines: The cap is the lower of:

beats.say: So Green's pay stops at eighteen crore. Toh baaki ka seven point two crore kahan gaya? Straight to the BCCI, for player welfare.
And here's the twist. KKR's purse still gets charged the full twenty-five point two crore.
Why the rule? To stop overseas stars from skipping the mega auction and cashing in at the smaller one.
lines: To stop overseas stars skipping the mega auction
and cashing in at the smaller one.

beats.say: The next test: the IPL 2027 mini-auction in Goa, on December sixteenth.
Fair rule, or unfair on the players? Tell me in the comments, and follow for a new breakdown every day.
